name: v1.3.11
body:
[English](#en-v1.3.11) | [中文](#cn-v1.3.11)

Highlights

- Added **[Aigei](https://www.aigei.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=sponsorship&utm_campaign=moneyprinterturbo)** as a stock video source. - Added **useapi.net** as a source for AI video and images. - Added **APINEBULA, APIXO Responses, AtmoRouter, and MartLLM** (formerly UberLLM) as LLM providers. - Improved **local rendering performance** by reducing per-frame compositing work for subtitles, letterboxing, and slide transitions. - Local video projects now return **individual rendered scene clips** in timeline order. This release also fixes cropping for footage with non-square pixels and reduces redundant cache verification during repeat renders. - Updated **Gemini speech synthesis** to Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS and improved **Edge TTS** timeout handling so long narration can finish while data is still arriving. ## Fixes and Improvements - Fixed FFmpeg audio validation that could accept a damaged MP3 or reject a valid short clip. Long files are checked without buffering the entire validation output. - Improved stock footage selection and playback. Sequential mode uses the rest of a clip before repeating it, faster playback gets enough footage to cover narration, and Pixabay can use a suitable 1080p file instead of downloading 4K. - Kept polling Seedance jobs when an Ark-compatible gateway reports `pending`. - Improved subtitle alignment with script lines and kept titles such as “Mr.” and “Dr.” with the names that follow. Accepted full-width brackets in narration pause tags. - Fixed voice previews that used the interface language instead of the selected voice’s language. Refined Spanish WebUI translations and file-size formatting. - Removed Markdown code fences from generated narration and preserved the first sentence when falling back to a social title. - Omitted or null API voice names use the default voice. CLI batch entries with a null voice inherit the batch voice. The API rejects blank scripts on `/audio` and `/subtitle`, and a null aspect ratio on `/videos`, before queuing a task. - Preserved Unicode separators inside JSONL strings. Cleared stale failure information after a successful local-project retry and made the agent helper honor `MPT_HOME`. ## What's Changed - Aigei, APINEBULA, and APIXO Responses integrations · [Aigei](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/d4877bc) · [APINEBULA](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/075f7ac) · [APIXO](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/110b14d) - useapi.net material sources by @useapi. [#1784](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1784) - AtmoRouter and MartLLM by @BeckleyTenriajeng and @al-global-tech. 重点更新

- 新增 **[爱给网](https://www.aigei.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=sponsorship&utm_campaign=moneyprinterturbo)** 视频素材来源。 - 新增 **useapi.net** AI 视频和图片素材来源。 - 新增 **APINEBULA、APIXO Responses、AtmoRouter 和 MartLLM**（原 UberLLM）大模型服务。 - 优化**本地视频渲染性能**，减少字幕、留黑边和滑动转场的逐帧合成开销。 - **本地视频项目**现在可按时间线顺序取得各场景的成片。修复非方形像素素材裁剪后变形的问题，并减少重复渲染时的缓存校验。 - 将 **Gemini 配音**迁移到 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS，改善 **Edge TTS** 超时处理，让持续接收数据的长文案配音能在总时限内完成。 ## 修复与改进 - 修复 FFmpeg 误接受损坏 MP3、误拒有效短音频的问题。校验长音频时按流读取，减少内存占用。 - 改善库存素材的下载与播放。顺序模式先播完当前片段再重复，高倍速下会下载足够覆盖旁白的素材，分辨率足够时优先使用 Pixabay 的 1080p 文件，减少不必要的 4K 下载。 - 兼容 Ark 网关返回的 Seedance `pending` 状态，任务排队期间继续轮询。 - 改善字幕按原稿行对齐的效果，避免把 `Mr.`、`Dr.` 等称谓与后续姓名拆到不同字幕行。配音停顿标签支持全角方括号。 - 试听示例按所选音色的语言播放，修复界面语言不同时的试听问题。完善西班牙语 WebUI 文案和文件大小显示。 - 清理 AI 生成文案中的 Markdown 代码块标记，生成备用社交标题时保留首句。 - API 省略音色或显式传入 `null` 时使用默认音色，CLI 批任务传入 `null` 时继承批次音色。`/audio`、`/subtitle` 的空白脚本以及 `/videos` 的空画幅会在入队前报错。 - 保留 JSONL 字符串里的 Unicode 分隔符。修复本地项目成功重试后仍显示旧失败阶段的问题，并让 Agent 辅助工具正确使用 `MPT_HOME`。 ## 主要变更 - 爱给网、APINEBULA 和 APIXO Responses 接入。 [爱给网](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/d4877bc) · [APINEBULA](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/075f7ac) · [APIXO](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/110b14d) - useapi.net 素材接入，感谢 @useapi。 [#1784](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1784) - AtmoRouter 接入与 MartLLM 接入及更名，感谢 @BeckleyTenriajeng、@al-global-tech。 [#1827](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1827) · [#1770](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1770) · [#1840](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1840) -
